
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /modes                                     │
  │  Available Modes                            │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    List all available mode toggles.

  Usage:
    /modes

  Details:
    Shows all modes (teach, awake, etc.) and their current on/off status.

  Examples:
    $ /modes

  Related: /teach  /awake
